resources.string: Adds a pack made for WhatsApp, or the stickers that WhatsApp saved on this phone

WhatsApp does not share its sticker packs with other apps. Two things on this phone are open: a .wastickers file, which apps like Sticker Maker export, and the folder where WhatsApp saves every sticker that you send or get. Both are read on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere, and WhatsApp does not learn about it. The stickers stay the work of the people who made them, so add only stickers that you may use.
A pack that Sticker Maker or a similar app exported
Add the stickers that WhatsApp saved
Select the “WhatsApp Stickers” folder under Android/media. Every sticker in it becomes one pack.
